examples.en: The execution of the plan took longer than we expected.
examples.zh: 這項計畫的執行比我們預期的花了更長的時間。

examples.en: Good execution matters more than a clever idea.
examples.zh: 好的執行比聰明的點子更重要。

examples.en: The team praised the smooth execution of the new program.
examples.zh: 團隊稱讚新方案執行得很順利。

examples.en: The writer spent ten years in exile before returning home.
examples.zh: 這位作家流亡十年後才回到家鄉。

examples.en: Many artists lived in exile during that period.
examples.zh: 那段時期有許多藝術家過著流亡生活。

examples.en: After the war, the old king lived quietly in exile.
examples.zh: 戰後，那位老國王在流亡中過著平靜的生活。

examples.en: The king decided to exile his advisor from the country.
examples.zh: 國王決定把他的顧問放逐出境。

examples.en: They were exiled for speaking against the government.
examples.zh: 他們因為批評政府而被放逐。

examples.en: The council voted to exile the leader from the city.
examples.zh: 議會投票決定把那位領袖逐出這座城市。

senses.zh: 異國風味的；外來的；奇特的

examples.en: We tried some exotic fruits at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市試吃了一些異國水果。

examples.en: She dreams of traveling to exotic places around the world.
examples.zh: 她夢想到世界各地充滿異國情調的地方旅行。

examples.en: The restaurant serves exotic dishes from South America.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應來自南美洲的異國料理。

examples.en: The scientists joined an expedition to the North Pole.
examples.zh: 科學家們加入了前往北極的探險隊。

examples.en: Our expedition left the base camp before sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們的探險隊在日出前離開了基地營。

examples.en: The class planned a short expedition to the local wetlands.
examples.zh: 全班規畫了一趟前往當地濕地的短程考察。

examples.en: She has great expertise in computer security.
examples.zh: 她在電腦安全方面有很豐富的專業知識。

examples.en: We need someone with expertise in tax law.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位具備稅法專業知識的人。

examples.en: His expertise helped the company solve the problem quickly.
examples.zh: 他的專業能力幫助公司迅速解決了問題。

senses.zh: 明確的；清楚的；直言不諱的

examples.en: The teacher gave us explicit instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們關於考試的明確指示。

examples.en: There is an explicit rule against eating in the library.
examples.zh: 圖書館裡有明文規定禁止飲食。

examples.en: He made an explicit promise to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 他明確承諾會準時完成工作。

examples.en: Space exploration has taught us a lot about the universe.
examples.zh: 太空探索讓我們對宇宙有了許多認識。

examples.en: The children enjoyed the exploration of the old garden.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜歡探索那座老花園。

examples.en: This book invites readers to begin their own exploration of art.
examples.zh: 這本書邀請讀者開始自己的藝術探索。

examples.en: The exterior of the building was painted bright white.
examples.zh: 這棟建築的外觀被漆成亮白色。

examples.en: They spent the weekend cleaning the exterior of their house.
examples.zh: 他們花了週末清洗房子的外牆。

examples.en: The car has a shiny exterior but an old engine.
examples.zh: 這輛車外觀光亮，引擎卻很老舊。

examples.en: Please paint the exterior walls before winter comes.
examples.zh: 請在冬天來臨前粉刷外牆。

examples.en: The exterior door was locked for the night.
examples.zh: 外側的門在夜間上了鎖。

examples.en: We checked the exterior surface of the pipe for cracks.
examples.zh: 我們檢查了水管外表面有沒有裂縫。

examples.en: You can save the files on an external hard drive.
examples.zh: 你可以把檔案存在外接式硬碟裡。

examples.en: External factors may affect the price of oil.
examples.zh: 外部因素可能會影響石油的價格。

examples.en: The company hired an external expert to review its accounts.
examples.zh: 公司聘請了一位外部專家來審查帳目。

examples.en: This soft fabric is perfect for making summer shirts.
examples.zh: 這種柔軟的布料很適合做夏天的襯衫。

examples.en: She chose a blue fabric for the new curtains.
examples.zh: 她為新窗簾選了藍色的布料。

examples.en: Friendship is part of the social fabric of a small town.
examples.zh: 友誼是小鎮社會結構的一部分。

examples.en: We had a fabulous time at the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末在海邊玩得非常開心。

examples.en: You look fabulous in that red dress.
examples.zh: 你穿那件紅色洋裝看起來好極了。

examples.en: The hotel offers a fabulous view of the mountains.
examples.zh: 這間旅館可以欣賞到絕佳的山景。

examples.en: A good map can facilitate travel in a new city.
examples.zh: 一張好地圖能讓人在陌生城市裡旅行更方便。

examples.en: The teacher will facilitate the group discussion after lunch.
examples.zh: 老師會協助引導午餐後的小組討論。

examples.en: New software may facilitate communication between departments.
examples.zh: 新軟體可以促進各部門之間的溝通。

examples.en: The faculty meets on the first Monday of every month.
examples.zh: 全體教師在每個月的第一個星期一開會。

examples.en: She teaches in the faculty of engineering at the university.
examples.zh: 她在這所大學的工學院任教。

examples.en: Grandpa still has all his mental faculties at the age of ninety.
examples.zh: 爺爺九十歲了，心智能力依然完好。

examples.en: Long flights often cause fatigue and headaches.
examples.zh: 長途飛行常會造成疲勞和頭痛。

examples.en: The driver stopped to rest because of fatigue.
examples.zh: 司機因為疲勞而停下來休息。

examples.en: Doctors say lack of sleep is a common cause of fatigue.
examples.zh: 醫生說睡眠不足是造成疲勞的常見原因。

examples.en: Fruits and vegetables are rich in fiber.
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜富含纖維。

examples.en: This jacket is made of a strong synthetic fiber.
examples.zh: 這件外套是用堅韌的合成纖維製成的。

examples.en: The internet here runs through a fiber cable under the street.
examples.zh: 這裡的網路是透過埋在街道下的光纖電纜傳輸。

examples.en: We installed a water filter in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們在廚房裝了一個濾水器。

examples.en: The coffee filter was full of wet grounds.
examples.zh: 咖啡濾紙裡全是濕的咖啡渣。

examples.en: She added a filter to make the photo look warmer.
examples.zh: 她加了一個濾鏡，讓照片看起來更溫暖。

examples.en: Please filter the water before you drink it.
examples.zh: 請先把水過濾再喝。

examples.en: You can filter the search results by price.
examples.zh: 你可以依價格篩選搜尋結果。

examples.en: The machine filters dust from the air.
examples.zh: 這台機器會過濾空氣中的灰塵。

examples.en: The government announced a new fiscal policy this week.
examples.zh: 政府本週宣布了新的財政政策。

examples.en: Our fiscal year begins in July.
examples.zh: 我們的會計年度從七月開始。

examples.en: The company reported strong profits in the last fiscal quarter.
examples.zh: 這家公司公布上一個會計季度的獲利很好。

examples.en: The company owns a fleet of delivery trucks.
examples.zh: 這家公司擁有一支送貨卡車車隊。

examples.en: A small fishing fleet left the harbor at dawn.
examples.zh: 一支小型漁船隊在黎明時離開了港口。

examples.en: The airline plans to add new planes to its fleet.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司計畫為機隊增添新飛機。

examples.en: Her fluency in English helped her get the job.
examples.zh: 她流利的英文幫助她得到了這份工作。

examples.en: Reading aloud every night can improve your fluency.
examples.zh: 每晚大聲朗讀可以提升你的流暢度。

examples.en: The test measures both fluency and accuracy.
examples.zh: 這項測驗同時評量流暢度與正確度。

examples.en: Drink plenty of fluid when you have a fever.
examples.zh: 發燒時要多喝水分。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the brake fluid in the car.
examples.zh: 技師檢查了這輛車的煞車油。

examples.en: Blood is a fluid that carries oxygen around the body.
examples.zh: 血液是一種在體內輸送氧氣的液體。

examples.en: The dancer's fluid movements amazed the audience.
examples.zh: 舞者流暢的動作讓觀眾驚嘆。

examples.en: The plan is still fluid, so we may change it.
examples.zh: 計畫還不確定，所以我們可能會更動。

examples.en: Water is a fluid substance at room temperature.
examples.zh: 水在室溫下是流動的物質。

examples.en: The blacksmith will forge a new gate for the farm.
examples.zh: 鐵匠會為農場打造一道新的大門。

examples.en: Someone tried to forge my signature on the form.
examples.zh: 有人試圖在表格上偽造我的簽名。

examples.en: The two schools hope to forge a strong partnership.
examples.zh: 兩所學校希望建立穩固的合作關係。

examples.en: The old forge in the village is now a museum.
examples.zh: 村裡那間舊鐵匠舖現在是一座博物館。

examples.en: Heat from the forge filled the small workshop.
examples.zh: 鍛造爐的熱氣充滿了小工坊。

examples.en: The blacksmith lit the forge early in the morning.
examples.zh: 鐵匠一大早就點燃了鍛造爐。

examples.en: Please send your report in PDF format.
examples.zh: 請以 PDF 格式寄出你的報告。

examples.en: The quiz show has a new format this season.
examples.zh: 這個益智節目這一季有了新的形式。

examples.en: Check the format of the date before you submit the form.
examples.zh: 送出表格前請先確認日期的格式。

examples.en: You need to format the USB drive before using it.
examples.zh: 使用這個隨身碟之前，你需要先將它格式化。

examples.en: She formatted the essay with wider margins.
examples.zh: 她把論文的邊界調寬來排版。

examples.en: Please format your resume in a clear and simple way.
examples.zh: 請用清楚簡單的方式為你的履歷排版。

senses.zh: 論壇；討論會；公開討論的場所

examples.en: I asked a question on an online forum about my laptop.
examples.zh: 我在網路論壇上問了一個關於我筆電的問題。

examples.en: The school held a forum on student safety.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦了一場關於學生安全的座談會。

examples.en: The town hall is a forum where residents share their ideas.
examples.zh: 市政廳是居民分享想法的公開場所。

examples.en: Good teachers foster a love of reading in children.
examples.zh: 好老師會培養孩子對閱讀的喜愛。

examples.en: The club aims to foster friendship among new students.
examples.zh: 這個社團的目標是促進新生之間的友誼。

examples.en: Our neighbors decided to foster two kittens for a month.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居決定寄養兩隻小貓一個月。

examples.en: She grew up in a foster family after her parents moved abroad.
examples.zh: 她在父母搬到國外後，在寄養家庭中長大。

examples.en: The foster parents treated the boy like their own son.
examples.zh: 寄養父母把這個男孩當作自己的兒子一樣對待。

examples.en: They became foster parents last spring.
examples.zh: 他們去年春天成為了寄養父母。

examples.en: A foul smell came from the old refrigerator.
examples.zh: 一股惡臭從那台舊冰箱傳出來。

examples.en: The foul weather forced us to cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣迫使我們取消了野餐。

examples.en: The river was too foul for anyone to swim in.
examples.zh: 這條河太髒了，沒有人能在裡面游泳。

examples.en: The referee called a foul on the tall player.
examples.zh: 裁判對那位高個子球員吹了犯規。

examples.en: He made three fouls in the first half.
examples.zh: 他在上半場犯規三次。

examples.en: The coach was upset about the foul in the last minute.
examples.zh: 教練對最後一分鐘的犯規感到不高興。

examples.en: Three quarters is a fraction we learned in math class.
examples.zh: 四分之三是我們在數學課學到的一種分數。

examples.en: Only a small fraction of students walk to school.
examples.zh: 只有一小部分學生走路上學。

examples.en: The new phone costs a fraction of the old price.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的價格只有舊價格的一小部分。

examples.en: She swept up the fragments of the broken cup.
examples.zh: 她把破掉的杯子碎片掃乾淨。

examples.en: I only heard a fragment of their conversation.
examples.zh: 我只聽到他們對話的片段。

examples.en: Archaeologists found a fragment of an ancient bowl.
examples.zh: 考古學家發現了一塊古代碗的碎片。

examples.en: The glass fell and fragmented on the floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃掉下去，在地板上碎裂開來。

examples.en: Too many small shops fragment the market.
examples.zh: 太多小商店使市場變得分散。

examples.en: The old wall began to fragment after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 那面舊牆在大雨後開始碎裂。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a framework for writing the essay.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們寫這篇作文的架構。

examples.en: The workers built a steel framework for the new bridge.
examples.zh: 工人為新橋搭建了鋼骨框架。

examples.en: This law creates a framework for protecting personal data.
examples.zh: 這項法律建立了保護個人資料的體系。

senses.zh: 加盟；連鎖經營權；特許經營店

examples.en: He bought a franchise of a famous coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他買下了一家知名咖啡店的加盟權。

examples.en: The franchise has more than two hundred stores in Asia.
examples.zh: 這個連鎖品牌在亞洲有兩百多家分店。

examples.en: She hopes to open a franchise near the train station.
examples.zh: 她希望在火車站附近開一家加盟店。

examples.en: The bank is investigating a case of credit card fraud.
examples.zh: 銀行正在調查一起信用卡詐欺案。

examples.en: He was accused of fraud after the company lost money.
examples.zh: 公司虧損後，他被指控詐欺。

examples.en: The man who sold fake tickets turned out to be a fraud.
examples.zh: 賣假票的那個人原來是個騙子。

examples.en: The train crossed the frontier early in the morning.
examples.zh: 火車在清晨越過了邊境。

examples.en: Soldiers guarded the frontier between the two countries.
examples.zh: 衛兵守衛著兩國之間的邊界。

examples.en: Space is often called the final frontier of human exploration.
examples.zh: 太空常被稱為人類探索的最後疆域。

examples.en: Our solar system is part of the Milky Way galaxy.
examples.zh: 我們的太陽系是銀河系的一部分。

examples.en: The telescope took a clear picture of a distant galaxy.
examples.zh: 望遠鏡拍下了一個遙遠星系的清晰照片。

examples.en: Scientists believe there are billions of stars in each galaxy.
examples.zh: 科學家相信每個星系裡有數十億顆恆星。

examples.en: The audience gasped when the lights suddenly went out.
examples.zh: 燈光突然熄滅時，觀眾都倒抽了一口氣。

examples.en: She gasped for air after running up the stairs.
examples.zh: 她跑上樓梯後上氣不接下氣。

examples.en: We gasped at the beautiful view from the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 我們看到山頂美麗的景色時驚嘆不已。

examples.en: A gasp of surprise filled the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡響起了一陣驚訝的倒抽氣聲。

examples.en: He let out a gasp when he opened the box.
examples.zh: 他打開盒子時倒抽了一口氣。

examples.en: With a gasp, she dropped the heavy bag.
examples.zh: 她倒抽一口氣，把沉重的袋子掉在地上。

examples.en: We have a family gathering at my grandmother's house every holiday.
examples.zh: 每逢假日，我們都會在外婆家舉行家庭聚會。

examples.en: A large gathering of fans waited outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 一大群球迷聚集在體育場外等候。

examples.en: The school invited parents to a gathering in the hall.
examples.zh: 學校邀請家長到禮堂參加聚會。

examples.en: Solar panels can generate electricity for the whole house.
examples.zh: 太陽能板可以為整棟房子發電。

examples.en: The new shop generated a lot of interest in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 這家新店在社區裡引起了很多關注。

examples.en: The program will generate a report at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 這個程式會在月底產生一份報告。

examples.en: The hospital has a backup generator in case of a power cut.
examples.zh: 醫院備有發電機，以防停電。

examples.en: We used a small generator during the camping trip.
examples.zh: 我們在露營時使用了一台小型發電機。

examples.en: The generator makes a loud noise when it runs.
examples.zh: 這台發電機運轉時會發出很大的聲音。

examples.en: Some diseases are caused by genetic problems.
examples.zh: 有些疾病是由基因問題引起的。

examples.en: The doctor asked about our family's genetic history.
examples.zh: 醫生詢問了我們家族的遺傳病史。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the genetic code of the plant.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究這種植物的基因密碼。

examples.en: She decided to study genetics at university.
examples.zh: 她決定在大學主修遺傳學。

examples.en: Genetics can explain why some families have the same eye color.
examples.zh: 遺傳學能解釋為什麼有些家族的眼睛顏色相同。

examples.en: Advances in genetics have changed modern medicine.
examples.zh: 遺傳學的進步改變了現代醫學。

examples.en: Science fiction is my favorite genre of movies.
examples.zh: 科幻片是我最喜愛的電影類型。

examples.en: What genre of music do you listen to most?
examples.zh: 你最常聽哪一種類型的音樂？

examples.en: The library has separate shelves for each genre.
examples.zh: 圖書館的每種體裁都有各自的書架。

examples.en: The glare of the sun made it hard to see the road.
examples.zh: 太陽的刺眼強光讓人很難看清路面。

examples.en: He gave his brother an angry glare.
examples.zh: 他憤怒地瞪了弟弟一眼。

examples.en: Sunglasses protect your eyes from the glare.
examples.zh: 太陽眼鏡能保護你的眼睛不受強光刺激。

examples.en: The teacher glared at the students who were talking.
examples.zh: 老師瞪著正在講話的學生。

examples.en: The sun glared off the windows of the tall building.
examples.zh: 陽光從高樓的窗戶反射出刺眼的光。

examples.en: She glared at me when I took her seat.
examples.zh: 我坐了她的位子，她就瞪了我一眼。

examples.en: It was a gloomy day with dark clouds all over the sky.
examples.zh: 那天天色陰暗，滿天都是烏雲。

examples.en: He felt gloomy after failing the exam.
examples.zh: 他考試不及格後心情很低落。

examples.en: The future of the company looks gloomy this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年的前景看起來黯淡。

examples.en: The bride looked gorgeous in her white dress.
examples.zh: 新娘穿著白色禮服，看起來美極了。

examples.en: We watched a gorgeous sunset from the hotel balcony.
examples.zh: 我們在旅館陽台上欣賞了一場絕美的夕陽。

examples.en: It is a gorgeous day, so let's go for a walk.
examples.zh: 今天天氣好極了，我們去散步吧。

examples.en: She works as a graphic designer for a small company.
examples.zh: 她在一家小公司擔任平面設計師。

examples.en: The book gives a graphic description of life on a farm.
examples.zh: 這本書生動地描寫了農場的生活。

examples.en: A graphic chart made the numbers easier to understand.
examples.zh: 一張圖表讓這些數字更容易理解。

examples.en: The report includes a graphic showing sales by month.
examples.zh: 報告中有一張顯示每月銷售額的圖表。

examples.en: Add a graphic to your slide to make it more interesting.
examples.zh: 在你的投影片中加一張圖像，讓它更有趣。

examples.en: The website uses a bright graphic on its front page.
examples.zh: 這個網站的首頁使用了一張鮮明的圖像。

examples.en: The story shows how greed can ruin a person's life.
examples.zh: 這個故事說明了貪婪如何毀掉一個人的生活。

examples.en: His greed for money made him lose many friends.
examples.zh: 他對金錢的貪婪使他失去了許多朋友。

examples.en: Greed led the company to ignore its workers.
examples.zh: 貪婪使公司忽視了員工。

examples.en: Dad cleaned the grill before the barbecue party.
examples.zh: 爸爸在烤肉派對前把烤架清乾淨。

examples.en: We bought a small grill for the backyard.
examples.zh: 我們為後院買了一個小烤肉爐。

examples.en: The new grill on Main Street is always crowded.
examples.zh: 大街上那家新開的燒烤餐廳總是很擠。

examples.en: We will grill fish and vegetables for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐要烤魚和蔬菜。

examples.en: He grilled the corn until it turned golden.
examples.zh: 他把玉米烤到變成金黃色。

examples.en: Please grill the chicken for about ten minutes.
examples.zh: 請把雞肉烤大約十分鐘。

examples.en: The doctor had a grim look on her face.
examples.zh: 醫生臉上的表情很凝重。

examples.en: The news about the flood was grim.
examples.zh: 關於洪水的消息令人沮喪。

examples.en: The situation looks grim for the small farm.
examples.zh: 這座小農場的處境看起來很嚴峻。

examples.en: He kept a firm grip on the rope.
examples.zh: 他緊緊抓住那條繩子。

examples.en: The new tires have a better grip on wet roads.
examples.zh: 新輪胎在濕滑路面上有更好的抓地力。

examples.en: The company finally lost its grip on the market.
examples.zh: 這家公司終於失去了對市場的掌控。

examples.en: The little girl gripped her mother's hand tightly.
examples.zh: 小女孩緊緊握住媽媽的手。

examples.en: The story gripped the readers from the first page.
examples.zh: 這個故事從第一頁起就緊緊抓住讀者。

examples.en: Please grip the handle with both hands.
examples.zh: 請用雙手握住把手。

examples.en: The company's gross income rose by ten percent this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年的總收入增加了百分之十。

examples.en: The gross weight of the box is five kilograms.
examples.zh: 這個箱子的毛重是五公斤。

examples.en: The smell from the garbage was really gross.
examples.zh: 垃圾的氣味真的很噁心。

examples.en: The school has clear guidelines for using computers.
examples.zh: 學校對於使用電腦有明確的規定。

examples.en: Follow the safety guidelines when you enter the lab.
examples.zh: 進入實驗室時請遵守安全準則。

examples.en: The guideline says students should wear their uniforms.
examples.zh: 這項準則規定學生應穿制服。

examples.en: Yogurt is good for your gut health.
examples.zh: 優格對腸道健康有益。

examples.en: My gut told me that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我的直覺告訴我有地方不對勁。

examples.en: He felt a sharp pain in his gut after lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐後覺得腹部劇烈疼痛。

examples.en: The fisherman gutted the fish before cooking it.
examples.zh: 漁夫在烹煮前先取出魚的內臟。

examples.en: Workers gutted the old building to make a new office.
examples.zh: 工人把舊大樓裡面全部拆空，改建成新的辦公室。

examples.en: She gutted the chicken and washed it carefully.
examples.zh: 她取出雞的內臟並仔細清洗。
